name: Vibe
author: disp06
description:
Lightweight music player tuned for the PCH-1000 OLED.
Plays MP3, OGG, FLAC (up to 24-bit/192 kHz) and WAV from ux0: and uma0: with tags (Cyrillic too) and cover art.
Keeps playing in the background and with the screen off. Screen-off timer, Always On mode with OLED burn-in shift, low clocks while the screen is dark.
Landscape and portrait layouts, true-black dark and light themes and three animated skins: Windows Phone Metro, Retro-Futurism (tape deck, scope, spectrum) and Minimal.
L/R skip tracks, Square toggles Always On, Select turns the screen off.
requirements: HENkaku or Enso. Put music anywhere on ux0 or uma0 (ux0:music opens first).
